subject: Vendor enrollment: Rivermark PO, AP onboarding & tax evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@rivermark.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment: initial packet and PO requirements

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Were excited to move forward as a preferred inference partner for Rivermark. Procurement asked me to share our AP onboarding essentials so you can provision Redwood as a vendor and tie invoices to POs. Attached is a short AP packet (rivermark_ap_packet.pdf) plus our billing-entity worksheet.

Quick summary of what we can provide now:
- Invoice PDF + embedded PO number in reference field
- Remittance to Redwood, Inc. (EIN and bank details on the worksheet)
- Electronic invoice delivery (SFTP or emailed PDF) — we prefer SFTP for high volume

Can you confirm the following on your side:
1) Preferred vendor portal (link or registration token) and whether a vendor portal account is required for first invoice.
2) Any mandatory PO fields we must populate (PO number only, or PO+cost-center/line-item mapping).
3) Tax documentation required for US vendors (W-9 vs W-8BEN-E) and whether you need the companys VAT/Tax ID.
4) Banking/remittance cutoff for same-month settlement (we often see 30/45-day cycles).

If it helps, we can pre-populate the vendor portal fields and upload the requested docs. Marcus (ccd) is our finance lead for vendor setup — he can provide a signed W-9 and banking confirmation.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: rivermark_ap_packet.pdf, redwood_billing_entity_sheet.xlsx

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@rivermark.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@rivermark.io
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: initial packet and PO requirements

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear packet. Quick answers below so we can get you registered:

1) Vendor portal: Rivermark uses our vendor portal (vendors.rivermark.io). Ive created a registration token for Redwood and included the link above — you can register directly or I can create the profile for you if you prefer.
2) PO fields: We require PO number + cost-center on every invoice. For platform services we also request an invoice line describing the monthly usage (eg: "Inference - Hosted API - July 2026").
3) Tax docs: For US entities we require a completed W-9 (signed PDF). If you were non-US wed need a W-8 form. We still capture VAT IDs for cross-border payment reporting.
4) Remittance: Standard payment terms are Net 45. Cutoff for same-month payment run is the 20th (files received and validated by 11:59PM UTC on the 20th).

A couple of notes from procurement:
- We require the vendor legal name to exactly match the W-9.
- For invoicing to attach to the PO, include the PO number in the invoice header, and put the cost-center in the invoice footer.

Please upload the signed W-9 and your bank confirmation to the portal. If you want, Marcus can send the bank memo directly to finance@rivermark.io (we only accept bank memos from the vendor finance contact).

Samantha Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Rivermark Technologies
procurement@rivermark.io

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@rivermark.io>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 13:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: initial packet and PO requirements

Hi Samantha, Jordan —

Thanks for the details. Jordan, Ive attached a signed W-9 (signed_W-9.pdf) and a bank confirmation PDF (uploaded to our shared Drive). I can also create the portal profile if that expedites things; Samantha, please advise whether you prefer vendor-created profile or procurement creates it on our behalf.

Logistics were confirming internally:
- Legal name on W-9: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (matches attached).
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: XX-XXXXXXX).
- Invoice format: PDF with a distinct "PO:" header field and cost-center footer. We can include a CSV line-level breakdown on request.

Naomi, could you confirm whether we should supply SFTP credentials for automated invoice delivery or simply upload to the portal? Our ops team prefers SFTP when volumes exceed 10 invoices/month.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: signed_W-9.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@rivermark.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: initial packet and PO requirements

Hi Samantha —

We registered Redwood on the vendor portal using the token you provided and uploaded the signed W-9 and the AP packet. Profile ID: RMK-V-93211 (portal confirmation screenshot attached in the portal). We set invoice delivery to email by default and created an SFTP credential pair for uploads (the public key is stored on our side; weve added the SFTP fingerprint to the portal metadata field).

Operational notes for your team:
- For PO matching, include PO number in the invoice header exactly as youll see in the PO (e.g., PO: RMK-987654).
- Cost-center format: 4-digit numeric (example: 2103). If you require a line-level CSV, we can provide a supplemental CSV with line-item breakdowns named invoice_lineitems_YYYYMMDD.csv.
- If you have withholdings for tax reasons, please notify finance@redwood.com within 7 days of invoice issuance so we can reconcile gross vs net amounts.

Next steps:
1) Procurement to issue the first PO and share the PO number back to finance@redwood.com.
2) Rivermark confirms whether they want email invoices or will initiate SFTP pulls starting in September.
3) If DocuSign is required for the vendor agreement, Jordan can circulate the envelope — we have an executed MSA draft ready.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the first invoice processed.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
